summary: Backend demo auth endpoints all working (200/OK, sent:true, token issued, demo-status lists 5 roles). BUT: public URL is NOT serving the CRA web_panel — supervisor `webpanel` is in FATAL state because port 3000 is already bound by supervisor `frontend` (Expo `expo start --port 3000`, PID 766). The Expo web bundle is being served instead of /app/web_panel/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx. Consequently the login page shown to end users only exposes 3 demo tiles (Partner, Merchant, Agent) — Admin (+919000000000) and Customer (+919000000004) tiles are NOT rendered anywhere, so the '4 one-click demo logins' acceptance criterion cannot pass. Partner tile → partner dashboard OK. Merchant tile → merchant home OK, Wallet tab renders (₹35,744.18 available, ₹35,244.18 withdrawable, Withdraw button visible). No CORS errors, no 'Demo login failed' toasts observed for the tiles that DO exist; all /api calls are same-origin as intended.

ui_bugs.issue: `webpanel` program FATAL: 'Something is already running on port 3000' — `frontend` (Expo) holds the port. Public URL therefore serves the Expo mobile web bundle (title 'AzoApp Partner', /index.bundle?platform=web) instead of the CRA web_panel. Login page shows only Partner/Merchant/Agent tiles; Admin & Customer demo tiles never render. Review request explicitly said `frontend` should be STOPPED and `webpanel` should own :3000 — actual state is inverted. Per instructions we did NOT touch supervisor.

integration_issues.issue: No [data-testid=demo-admin] on served /login (Expo bundle only exposes partner/merchant/agent tiles). Cannot exercise the flow from UI. Backend supports it: POST /api/auth/verify-otp with +919000000000/123456 returns admin token.
No [data-testid=demo-customer] on served /login. Same reason as above. Backend returns valid customer token for +919000000004/123456.

verified_working: GET  /api/auth/demo-status → demo_mode:true, roles present: admin(1), partner(10), customer(32), merchant(1), agent(1)
Web (Expo-served) /login → click 'Login as Partner' tile → partner dashboard renders (Raj, ₹449.25 earnings, Track jobs, missed-job card). No CORS, no error toast.

Web (Expo-served) /login → click 'Login as Merchant' tile → merchant home (Sharma Electricals ₹508 lifetime commission). Tap Wallet tab → /wallet renders (₹35,744.18 available balance card, Withdraw button).
All /api/* network requests go to same-origin host (756fe6c8-b693-4ecc-9106-a590d19672be.preview.emergentagent.com). Zero CORS console errors.
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix supervisor port 3000 ownership. Either set `frontend` autostart=false, or move Expo off :3000, or ensure `webpanel` starts first. Right now `webpanel` FATAL-loops with 'Something is already running on port 3000' and Expo bundle is served publicly. The review-request premise ('web_panel owns port 3000') is not satisfied in this fork.
Once webpanel owns :3000, retest the 4 tiles — src/pages/auth/Login.jsx correctly iterates ['admin','partner','customer','merchant'] and demo-status returns all four, so the flow should just work.
Optional: Add a supervisor `priority=` so webpanel binds :3000 before frontend, and/or start frontend on a different port when both need to coexist.
critical_code_review_comments: /etc/supervisor/conf.d/webpanel.conf: `frontend` and `webpanel` both autostart=true and both target port 3000 → race condition, currently `frontend` wins on every restart.
web_panel/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx: quickLogin() correctly calls send-otp then verify-otp and toasts 'Demo login failed' on any error; no bug in the code itself, purely deployment/routing issue.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (2 of 4 tiles even exist in served UI; those 2 work end-to-end)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The public URL serves the Expo bundle. Run `sudo supervisorctl status` first — if `webpanel` is FATAL, no amount of Playwright work on data-testid=demo-admin/demo-customer will succeed because those tiles are not rendered by the Expo login page. Grep the served HTML for 'AzoApp Partner' (Expo) vs an empty <div id="root"> without expo-reset styles (CRA) to distinguish. Backend API endpoints under /api are healthy and correctly proxied.

rca_of_the_issue.symptom: 'demo-admin' and 'demo-customer' tiles are absent; only Partner/Merchant/Agent tiles present.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: supervisor `webpanel` program is FATAL (`Something is already running on port 3000`), so the CRA web_panel never starts. Supervisor `frontend` (Expo `expo start --port 3000`, PID 766) took port 3000 first. Kubernetes ingress therefore proxies :3000 → Expo web bundle, whose login page differs from the CRA Login.jsx (it exposes partner/merchant/agent only, per `Only Partner, Merchant & Agent numbers can sign in here`).
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) curl -s https://<preview>/ | head → title 'AzoApp Partner' with /index.bundle?platform=web (Expo signature). 2) sudo supervisorctl status → webpanel FATAL, frontend RUNNING. 3) tail /var/log/supervisor/webpanel.out.log → 'Something is already running on port 3000'.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Stop/disable `frontend` (Expo) or reassign its port; then `sudo supervisorctl restart webpanel`. Or set priority/startsecs so webpanel binds :3000 before Expo. Do not modify web_panel/.env — it is intentionally empty per problem statement.
